data.name: VRLF - Virtual Reality Lightgun Framework
data.detailed_description:
VRLF: Virtual Reality Lightgun Framework is a framework for playing light gun games using your VR controllers as the gun. For too long, playing light gun games at home required expensive special hardware or a fancy CRT monitor - but no more! Using your existing VR headset and controllers, VRLF offers a simple and immersive way to adapt light gun games and make them playable, accurate and immersive.

  • Support for multiple control types (shoot off screen to reload, crouch to reload, DSU protocol for Dolphin and more)

  • User configurable via JSON profiles for maximum compatibility with as many games as possible.

  • Steam Workshop support for sharing user profiles - Supports any game you want it to! 

  • 3D scans of popular home light guns including G-Con45 and Wii Zapper. Many controllers and guns to choose from!

  • Online multiplayer support. Join a friend through Steam and stream video/inputs to recreate local 2 player light gun action. Requires fast internet!

  • Ships with support for lots of light gun games available on Steam including but not limited to: The House of the Dead Overkill, The House of the Dead Remake, The House of the Dead 2 Remake, Heavy Fire series, Blue Estate, Railbreak, BioCrisis and more. Some games require mods to enable light gun support.

Note: Virtual Reality Lightgun Framework does not include any light gun games, the user brings their own games and uses the framework to make them playable in VR.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 7600 or Intel Core i5 13400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • VR Support: Required
  • Additional Notes: A more powerful system may be required for certain games
